seam: logos ListTheory decision vector v1 (UNFROZEN v1)
note: Language-AGNOSTIC tri-core THEORY-DECISION agreement vectors for the reified list-relation ListTheory (logos-core/list-theory@1.0.0, ADR 0016 Shelf A1). Each entry is a GROUND atom (predicate + args) together with the PINNED Theory.decide outcome. The decision oracle is the Rust ListTheory::decide; contract/{rs,go,ts} ListTheory.decide MUST reproduce every outcome byte-for-byte (the §7 dual-conformance law). The theory decides the relations length/2, nth0/3, last/2 over the ontos/data REIFIED list embedding list(e0..e_{n-1}) = Tuple(Atom("list"), e0, ..., e_{n-1}) (spec §5.5) — the native A1 fast-path complement of the Shelf-B cons-cell lists@1.1.0 prelude (SAME relations, DIFFERENT representation). is_list/1 is already a TermTheory recognizer and is NOT owned here. Args are encoded as: {"atom": "<utf8>"} = a bare Atom of those UTF-8 bytes; {"int": N} = the frozen ontos-data int embedding Tuple(Atom("int"), Atom(sign||be-magnitude)); {"list": [..]} = the ontos-data list embedding of the encoded children; {"tuple": [..]} = a raw compound Tuple of the encoded children (used to encode cons cells and non-list shapes). length(list(e0..e_{n-1}), int(n)) holds iff arg0 is a list of n elements and arg1 is the canonical int embedding of n; nth0(int(i), list(e0..), e_i) is 0-indexed (Prolog/SWI order index,list,element); last(list(e0..e_{n-1}), e_{n-1}) holds iff arg0 is a NON-EMPTY list and arg1 is its last element. Outcome is "holds" or {"fails": "<code>"} where the code is one of the pinned host-band sub-codes list_does_not_hold | list_bad_arity | list_unknown_predicate. owns: length, nth0, last.

decisions.name: length_empty_holds
decisions.note: length(list(), int(0)) — the empty list has length 0

decisions.name: length_singleton_holds
decisions.note: length(list(a), int(1))

decisions.name: length_two_holds
decisions.note: length(list(a, b), int(2))

decisions.name: length_three_holds
decisions.note: length(list(a, b, c), int(3))

decisions.name: length_int_elements_holds
decisions.note: elements may be any ground term — length(list(int(1), int(2)), int(2))

decisions.name: length_nested_list_element_holds
decisions.note: a list element may itself be a list embedding — length(list(list(a), b), int(2))

decisions.name: length_wrong_count_fails
decisions.note: length(list(a, b), int(3)) — count mismatch

decisions.name: length_empty_wrong_count_fails
decisions.note: length(list(), int(1)) — empty list is not length 1

decisions.name: length_non_list_atom_fails
decisions.note: length(not_a_list, int(0)) — arg0 is not a list embedding

decisions.name: length_cons_form_fails
decisions.note: the CONS form .(a, []) is NOT the reified list() embedding -> fails (this theory is over list())

decisions.name: length_bare_nil_atom_fails
decisions.note: the bare nil atom [] is not the empty list() embedding

decisions.name: length_unlabeled_tuple_fails
decisions.note: a bare unlabeled Tuple(a, b) is not a list embedding (no "list" label)

decisions.name: length_non_int_count_atom_fails
decisions.note: length(list(a), "1") — a number-shaped atom is not the int embedding

decisions.name: length_bad_arity_one
decisions.note: length/1 is not the relation

decisions.name: length_bad_arity_three
decisions.note: length/3 is not the relation

decisions.name: nth0_index0_holds
decisions.note: nth0(int(0), list(a, b, c), a)

decisions.name: nth0_index1_holds
decisions.note: nth0(int(1), list(a, b, c), b)

decisions.name: nth0_last_index_holds
decisions.note: nth0(int(2), list(a, b, c), c) — the highest valid 0-index

decisions.name: nth0_singleton_holds
decisions.note: nth0(int(0), list(x), x)

decisions.name: nth0_int_element_holds
decisions.note: the element may be an int embedding — nth0(int(1), list(int(7), int(8)), int(8))

decisions.name: nth0_nested_list_element_holds
decisions.note: nth0(int(0), list(list(a), b), list(a))

decisions.name: nth0_wrong_element_fails
decisions.note: nth0(int(1), list(a, b, c), a) — wrong element at a valid index

decisions.name: nth0_out_of_range_fails
decisions.note: nth0(int(3), list(a, b, c), _) — index == length is out of range (0-indexed)

decisions.name: nth0_empty_list_fails
decisions.note: nth0(int(0), list(), _) — no element 0 in an empty list

decisions.name: nth0_negative_index_fails
decisions.note: nth0(int(-1), list(a), _) — a negative index has no element

decisions.name: nth0_non_int_index_fails
decisions.note: nth0("0", list(a), a) — a number-shaped atom index is not the int embedding

decisions.name: nth0_non_list_fails
decisions.note: nth0(int(0), not_a_list, a) — arg1 is not a list embedding

decisions.name: nth0_cons_form_fails
decisions.note: the cons form .(a, []) is not the reified list() embedding

decisions.name: nth0_bad_arity_two
decisions.note: nth0/2 is not the relation

decisions.name: nth0_bad_arity_four
decisions.note: nth0/4 is not the relation

decisions.name: last_singleton_holds
decisions.note: last(list(x), x)

decisions.name: last_two_holds
decisions.note: last(list(a, b), b)

decisions.name: last_three_holds
decisions.note: last(list(a, b, c), c)

decisions.name: last_int_element_holds
decisions.note: last(list(int(1), int(2)), int(2))

decisions.name: last_nested_list_element_holds
decisions.note: last(list(a, list(b)), list(b))

decisions.name: last_wrong_element_fails
decisions.note: last(list(a, b), a) — a is not the last element

decisions.name: last_empty_fails
decisions.note: last(list(), _) — the empty list has no last element

decisions.name: last_non_list_fails
decisions.note: last(not_a_list, _) — arg0 is not a list embedding

decisions.name: last_cons_form_fails
decisions.note: the cons form .(x, []) is not the reified list() embedding

decisions.name: last_bad_arity_one
decisions.note: last/1 is not the relation

decisions.name: last_bad_arity_three
decisions.note: last/3 is not the relation
